local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states requirements directly in credits; no conversion needed. Requirements: 4 English (incl. American Literature and one senior English), 4 math (incl. Personal Finance and one senior math), 3 social studies (U.S. History), 3 science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology), 1.5 PE, 1 visual art, 1 music, 0.5 health, 0.5 computer applications, 10 electives.

flexible_pathways_listed: early college (Early College at Your High School, WMCC; Early College Program)
High School Completion Program (HSCP, with NEKLS)
notes: Credit-based graduation (28.5 credits, p.10) with grade promotion by credit minimums (p.10-11). Grades are numeric (p.11) with a 70% passing grade (p.15). The proficiency-based learning section (p.14) lists six proficiency areas and says students 'will be able to demonstrate proficiency'; the catalog does not explicitly say proficiency is a condition of graduation, so hybrid is recorded on that basis. Required local courses: American Literature; Personal Finance; Physics, Chemistry and Biology (starting Class of 2027, p.52); U.S. History (p.56); Health (p.44); Computer Applications (p.37); 1 credit visual art (p.32); 1 credit music (p.48). PE: 1.5 credits, minimum 1 credit in PE classroom, up to 0.5 from sports seasons (p.49). Catalog is the 2025-26 program of studies (68 PDF pages); no 2026-27 version was found in Phase 1.
